title: Seabed Mining Claims Nearly Quadrupled To 31
hook: Seabed mining claims nearly quadrupled to 31.
closing: The rush is accelerating before the world agrees who should control the seabed.
question: Should seabed mining pause?

segments.say: Seabed mining claims reached 31, turning a remote frontier into a crowded industrial race.
Seabed nodules hold 44 million tonnes of cobalt, making the ocean floor an enormous target.
Calls for a seabed mining pause reached 37 countries, showing opposition is growing with the rush.
